prompt: In which year was a number of procumbent pearlwort (Sagina procumbens) plants first found on Gough Island in the South Atlantic Ocean, capable of dramatically transforming the upland plant ecosystem?
answer: The procumbent pearlwort plants were first found on Gough Island in **1998**.
